_note: THE public list of every Pro speed-up and Pro feature, with the numbers measured for it. One entry per perk; adding a speed-up = adding one entry here, plus its id in that release's "pro_perks" in whats_new.json. It feeds the Now in Pro section at the top of What's new (whats_new.py), the Pro moment after a Free render (pro_speedup.py: the Fast draft ratios and the moment line) and the saved-time figure (PRO_SPEEDUPS in mlx_ltx_panel.py). Ids are stable across the Studio. Public wording only: what people get and the measured gain, never how it works (no step counts, adapters, decoders or recipe names; the H3 speed perk is 'Faster Flex Turbo'). Every number is a measurement described in measured.source. 'since' is the Studio version a perk first shipped in, null while it is not released yet (Now in Pro never shows those as new). An unreleased perk with a 'next' line is TEASED instead: 'Coming next in Pro' under Now in Pro, or on its own when a release adds nothing to Pro (owner, 14 Nov 2026: "if we don't have something to release in Pro, we can still tease it"). No 'next' = kept quiet. A 'next' line is public, plain and only measured facts; remove it (or let the gate remind you) when 'since' is set. 'now' is the one line Now in Pro shows; 'gain' the short measured figure; 'moment' the gentle in-app line ({pro} and {free} are filled from this Mac's own render time; shown at most a few times a week, see PRO_HINT_* in mlx_ltx_panel.py).
